answer: Require each agent identity to stake a costly, time-locked bond before it can earn: a newcomer must lock funds and build verifiable work history, so a flood of fresh identities faces the same rising tide of cost while honest incumbents keep accumulated reputation. An identity that misbehaves loses its stake, and its history becomes a relic - useless pigment on a dead record - because reputation cannot be copied or transferred to a new face. Attackers must therefore pay full price per identity, making a Sybil swarm unprofitable.
